meta.name: understand-diff
meta.description: Use when you need to analyze git diffs or pull requests to understand what changed, affected components, and risks

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析代码变更，理解影响与风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要审查代码变更或理解他人提交的影响
copy.tagline_en: Analyze code changes to understand impact and risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to review code changes or understand the impact of others' commits

howto.what: 分析代码改动时，Claude 会读取知识图谱(缺文件先让用户运行 /understand)，用 git 列出变更文件，在图谱中找对应节点与其关联边，输出改动与受影响组件、架构层及风险，并生成 diff-overlay.json 供可视化看板使用。
howto.when: 当用户需要分析 git 差异或 PR，以了解改动内容、受影响组件和风险时触发。

say.text: 分析当前未提交的改动，说说哪些组件会受影响
say.note: 会运行完整分析流程并输出结构化结果。

say.text: 对比 main 分支，评估这次改动的风险
say.note: 会列出改动、关联组件并给出风险评级。

say.text: 查看 PR #12 的改动会触及哪些架构层
say.note: 会获取该 PR 的差异并匹配架构层。

howto.what_en: When analyzing a diff, Claude reads the knowledge graph (or tells the user to run /understand if it's missing), lists changed files via git, finds matching nodes and connected edges, then reports changed & affected components, layers, risks, and writes diff-overlay.json for the dashboard.
howto.when_en: When the user asks to analyze a git diff or pull request to understand what changed, which components are affected, and what risks exist.

say_en.text: Analyze my current uncommitted changes and tell which components are affected
say_en.note: Uses git diff and knowledge graph to produce analysis.

say_en.text: Compare the changes on this branch against main and assess the risk
say_en.note: Runs the diff analysis against the base branch.

say_en.text: List which architecture layers PR #12 touches
say_en.note: Fetches the PR diff and maps it to layers via the graph.
